title: Rollout gap: a recording already running when this ships has no live-recording entry
evidence: The claim is written by cli.ts record at start. A recorder started by the old code (or any process that bypasses cli.ts and calls runRecord directly) leaves no entry, so send-now cannot see it until it exits.
reproduction: Start a recorder with the pre-change CLI, deploy, send-now the same meeting: accepted.
fix_direction: None needed beyond time (recordings are bounded by --until); the tab-capture profile lock still refuses an overlapping capture.

title: scripts/webinar/send-now-host.test.ts 'duplicate through the REAL live-job reader' fails at the base commit 9e24d1f
evidence: Fails identically in the main tree and this worktree (11/12): the scheduled job fixture has no tenant tag, so readLiveJobs assertTenantTag (ISS-ALERTID-006) throws and the plan is 'unreadable' not 'duplicate'. Not caused by this unit.
fix_direction: Tag the fixture job file with tenantId 'tenant-a' in that test.

title: Window between send-now plan and the child's claim; real CLI never run
evidence: Two send-now requests that both plan before the first child has claimed are both launched; the second child is refused at claim (tested with a fake runRecord) and exits, which the API reports as 502 only if it exits inside livenessMs (2 s). Chrome/OBS/real cli.ts record were not launched in this unit.
reproduction: Two POSTs within the tsx start-up time of the child.
fix_direction: Optional: have the adapter claim on behalf of the child (needs the child's pid) or lengthen livenessMs; live check once a safe window exists.

title: Replacing a STALE live-recording entry is not atomic: two simultaneous claimers can both win and both record
evidence: claimLiveRecording (live-recording/live-recording.ts): on EEXIST it reads the holder, finds it dead, then rmSync(file) and loops to linkSync. Claimer B can read the dead holder, claimer A can rm + link its own live entry, and B's rmSync then deletes A's live entry and B links: both return ok.
reproduction: Seed raw/webinars/live-recordings/t1/<hash>.json with a dead pid (2147483000). Spawn 3 real node processes that call claimLiveRecording for the same meeting at a barrier time. Checker probe: fresh dir 20/20 exactly one winner; stale-seeded dir 19/20, run 9 had two winners (a and c ok).
fix_direction: Replace the stale file by atomic rename to a unique graveyard name only if its content still equals what was judged dead, or serialise stale replacement with an exclusive lock file; re-verify the holder after the winning link. Needs a stale-seeded multi-process regression test.

title: scripts/webinar/send-now-host.test.ts is red on the main tree since merge 2504e81: semantic conflict between lane/alerttenant and lane/sendnowapi
evidence: Test 'duplicate through the REAL live-job reader' writes raw/webinars/scheduled/job-1.json with url, sessionId, until but no tenantId. 4360058 (merge lane/alerttenant, 12:09) made readLiveJobs call assertTenantTag(job, tenant, ...) which throws on an untagged file, so the real reader answers unreadable instead of duplicate. lane/sendnowapi was cut before that and merged at 2504e81 (12:42); the two were never run together, so main has been red (11/12) since that merge. Product behaviour is correct (untagged file = cannot tell); the test fixture is stale.
reproduction: node --test --import tsx scripts/webinar/send-now-host.test.ts on master/main tree: 11 pass 1 fail, actual [false,'unreadable'] expected [false,'duplicate'] at send-now-host.test.ts:77.
fix_direction: Add tenantId:'tenant-a' to the job-1.json fixture (and keep bad.json untagged/invalid for the 503 case); then run the file in the merge gate.
